messages:
mike: Heads-up: I found a reproducible duplicate-create with the Python SDK when auth refresh + aiohttp connector reuse happens during a retry. Happened on a POST that should be non-idempotent but we were resending the body without an idempotency-key.

sara: ouch. do you have a tiny repro?

mike: yes — minimal repro attached below (shortened). behavior: first request 401 refresh -> token grabbed -> retry happens but idempotency header is missing on retry. server processed the create twice.

mike: request logs (sanitized):
```
-> POST /v1/resource/create
   Authorization: Bearer <short-lived-token>
   Idempotency-Key: 0a1b2c3d
   Content-Length: 512
<- 401 Unauthorized (token expired)
(retry logic triggers token refresh)
-> POST /v1/resource/create
   Authorization: Bearer <new-token>
   Content-Length: 512
   # Note: Idempotency-Key header missing here
<- 201 Created
```

alex: hmm, is aiohttp reusing the ClientRequest object or something and we mutate headers on refresh? I've seen header copy bugs before.

mike: I printed the prepared request before and after refresh. the SDK's retry path reconstructs the request but our auth hook only sets `Authorization` and forgets to copy custom user headers unless they live in the session defaults.

sara: ok that sounds like a clear bug. two concerns: (1) correctness: definitely dangerous to replay non-idempotent with missing idempotency header, (2) DX/semantics: users expect SDK to preserve headers they set, esp for idempotency and tracing.

noah: quick question — should we special-case idempotency-key in the SDK and keep a separate request attribute so we never drop it? or ensure the retry path clones all user-provided headers?

mike: my preference is conservative: when a request is flagged non-idempotent by method (POST/PUT without idempotency-key) we should NOT automatically replay on 5xx / auth refresh. If user supplies idempotency-key, guarantee it persists across retries. Also add explicit SDK param `idempotency_key=` to make it ergonomic.

alex: +1. implementation-wise for aiohttp async client: ensure we build a fresh headers dict = {**user_headers} before adding auth. and in the auth refresh callback, mutate only Authorization header. also add test covering replay with and without idempotency header.

mike: proposed action items:
- patch: retry path should copy user headers before auth injection (mx1)
- patch: add optional `idempotency_key` param on client methods that sets header and is preserved (mx2)
- test: async and sync parity tests for idempotency replay (mx1)
- doc: note that SDK will not auto-retry POST without idempotency_key set (mx1)

sara: sounds good. can we also consider server-side guidance: return 409 when duplicate idempotency-key used to create? but that's a product API change.

mike: yes that's product. for now we need to limit SDK risk.

noah: I can take mx1 (header copy + tests) today. I'll open a PR with a tiny repro under examples/repro_idempotency.py and an integration test that simulates 401 then 201.

alex: I'll own mx2 (idempotency_key param + typing updates). update typing + async docs to show param on AsyncClient.create(..., idempotency_key=...). Also add note to changelog about preserving headers.

mike: thanks. two nitty things: backoff semantics — we should not consider auth-refresh-induced retry part of backoff budget for user retries. e.g., token refresh retry should be immediate and not count against retry_count for 5xx/backoff. otherwise users unexpectedly hit their retry budget and see errors.

sara: good catch. can you file a small issue about separating auth-refresh retry vs network/backoff retries?

mike: filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/1423 (link in thread)

devex-bot: scheduled reminder set for the PR review in 48h :robot_face:

noah: thanks — will ping when PR is up. also adding a small sample that toggles `connector=ClientSession(connector=TCPConnector(limit=...))` to try to reproduce header-drop with session reuse.

alex: one more: ensure the streaming/generator path also preserves idempotency header (that's a separate codepath). I hit a bug where stream retries lost custom headers. I'll add that to my PR checklist.

sara: awesome. mike, do you want us to block a patch release? or include in next minor?

mike: this is high-risk for duplicate-creates for some customers — prefer a patch release with the header-copy fix and tests (mx1) and ship idempotency_key param in next minor.

noah: PR incoming in ~3h. I'll mark it patch.

mike: thanks all :thumbsup:
